author: sereus.org

sections.text: Failure to honor any of the obligations specified in this Agreement.
sections.title: Failure of Duty

sections.text: Making any representation in connection with the Tally that is factually untrue.
sections.title: False Representation

sections.text: Failure to complete a Credit Lift transaction previously committed to, due to intentional manipulation of software and/or the network.
sections.title: Failure to Complete

sections.text: Failure to complete a Credit Lift honestly and in accordance with the Taleus protocol as published by sereus.org and demonstrated by its reference implementation.
sections.title: Attempt to Cheat

sections.text: Failure to provide sufficient connections to accomplish necessary Credit Lifts, followed by failure to make a Recipient whole by alternative means.
sections.title: Failure to Honor

text: Any of the following actions by either Party constitutes a breach of this Agreement, thereby deeming that Party to be in Default.
title: Contract Breaches and Conditions of Default
